title: A protocol for imaging of the Drosophila visceral muscle
protocol: Decapitate wild type flies or Mef2>mCD8GFP flies in PBS using microscissors.
Expose the forepart of the intestine by selectively removing legs, thoracic muscles, and the thoracic junction cuticle to the abdomen using a pair of forceps.
Make an incision from the beginning of the abdomen to the anus without damaging the intestine.
Grab the anus and pull carefully to separate the whole intestine from the abdominal cuticle.
Remove the reproductive organ from the dissected intestine.
Incubate the intestine in 4% PFA for 20 minutes. Nutation is optional for subsequent procedures except for antibody incubation.
Wash the tissue twice in 0.1% PBST for 5 minutes.
Permeabilize the intestine by incubating it in 0.5% PBST for 10 minutes.
Wash the tissue three times in 0.1% PBST for 5 minutes.
Add Hoechst at a ratio of 1:400 and FITC/TRITC-conjugated phalloidin at a ratio of 1:200 to the tissue-containing solution.
Incubate the mixture for approximately two hours at room temperature on a nutator.
Incubate the tissue in 3% bovine serum albumin in 0.1% PBST for 30 minutes at room temperature for blocking.
Add primary antibodies including anti-mouse tubulin antibody (Abcam, ab6046, 1:200) and anti-mouse myosin heavy chain antibody (DSHB, ALD-58, 1:100), and incubate overnight at 4°C.
Wash the tissue by nutating in 0.1% PBST three times for five minutes each.
Treat with anti-mouse dye-conjugated antibodies (1:200), FITC/TRITC-conjugated phalloidin antibodies (1:200), and Hoechst (1:400) for two hours at room temperature in the dark.
Wash the tissue by nutating in 0.1% PBST three times for five minutes each, followed by washing with PBS once for five minutes.
Place the whole tissue on a slide glass and mount it in SlowFade solution (Invitrogen, CA, ID: S36936) with a cover glass.
Wash the tissue two times in 0.5% PBST for ten minutes each and discard the washing solution.
Add 0.1 M sodium citrate in 0.1% PBST and incubate the tissue at 65°C for thirty minutes.
Wash the tissue with PBS twice for ten minutes each.
As a control group, add DNase solution (1.5 μl of DNase, 3 μl of 10 mg/ml BSA, 1.5 μl of 1 M Tris buffer with pH7.5, and 24 μl of H2O).
Incubate experimental samples in 2 μl of TUNEL enzyme and 18 μl of buffer at 37°C for 2 hours.
Wash tissue in 0.1% PBST for 10 minutes.
Incubate tissue with phalloidin-TRITC/FITC and Hoechst for 1 hour at RT.
Wash samples 3 times in 0.1% PBST for 10 minutes each wash.
Mount the sample for confocal imaging as described in the previous immunostaining section.
Obtain Z-stack images of the intestine using a confocal microscope (LSM710, Carl Zeiss).
Make a projection image using the Z-stack images.
Measure width of a few regions of the intestine to represent its diameter.
